description: The human's delegation inbox (the Dev-Agent tab 'Delegationen'): questions agents handed to this person with delegate_to_user, and permission questions. Same rows and same order as the tab — open first, oldest first. Default status open. Each row: id, summary, priority, status/stand, kind, agent, session, open question count, waiting_for_dependency, url (opens it in the app). Only the caller's own delegations in the ACTIVE tenant. Read the full questions with get_user_delegation.

kind.description: question = ordinary question, permission = tool-permission question.

offset.description: Number of entries to skip (for paging)

query.description: Search like the tab: id, summary, session, comment, agent name, question texts, answers, recommendations.

session_id.description: Only delegations from this Dev-Agent session.

status.description: open (default) | answered (answered, resuming or done) | cancelled | all

name: list_user_delegations
